description: Independent hand-derived golden fixtures for Nimphy STEP-008 sensitivity analysis calculation engine.

cases.description: Ebook standard $4.99 with 500 units, 1 MB delivery, 0% cost variance under round_half_up per_unit with all 3 declared drivers
cases.derivation: Baseline $4.99 at 70% royalty = 349.3 -> 349 cents. Delivery for 1 MB = 15 cents. Unit contrib = 334 cents. At 500 units, baseline contrib = 167,000 cents ($1,670.00). Perturbing listPrice by 100 ($1.00) gives 399 ($279 - 15 = 264c * 500 = 132,000c, delta -35,000) and 599 ($419 - 15 = 404c * 500 = 202,000c, delta +35,000), impact 35,000. Perturbing units by 100 gives 400 (400 * 334 = 133,600, delta -33,400) and 600 (600 * 334 = 200,400, delta +33,400), impact 33,400. Perturbing costVariance by 10% gives -10% (cost 15 * 0.9 = 13.5 -> 14c, unit 335, total 167,500, delta +500) and +10% (cost 15 * 1.1 = 16.5 -> 17c, unit 332, total 166,000, delta -1,000), impact 1,000. Ranking: listPriceMinor (rank 1), units (rank 2), costVariancePercent (rank 3).

cases.description: Ebook list price perturbation crossing tier boundary (299 to 199 in 35% tier, 399 in 70% tier)
cases.derivation: Baseline $2.99 (standard_mid 70%): roy 209, cost 15, unit contrib 194c. Total 200 * 194 = 38,800 cents. Lower price $1.99 drops into standard_low (35% tier!): roy = round(199 * 0.35) = round(69.65) = 70c. Cost = 15. Unit contrib = 70 - 15 = 55c. Total 200 * 55 = 11,000 cents (delta = 11,000 - 38,800 = -27,800). Upper price $3.99 remains standard_mid (70%): roy = round(399 * 0.70) = 279c. Cost = 15. Unit contrib = 279 - 15 = 264c. Total 200 * 264 = 52,800 cents (delta = 52,800 - 38,800 = +14,000). Max impact = max(|-27,800|, |14,000|) = 27,800. Units pert 50: lower 150 * 194 = 29,100 (delta -9,700), upper 250 * 194 = 48,500 (delta +9,700), impact 9,700. Ranking: listPriceMinor (rank 1), units (rank 2).
